description: This file is the __init__.py of the auth package, mainly used to import specific functions, classes, and errors related to JWT authentication and FastAPI dependencies, and expose them as part of the package's public API.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Creates a JWT access token with given payload.

methods.name: decode_token
methods.description: Decodes and verifies a JWT token to extract payload.

methods.name: validate_token
methods.description: Validates the JWT token for expiration and integrity.

methods.name: extract_user_id
methods.description: Extracts user ID from a valid token.

methods.name: get_token_expiration
methods.description: Retrieves expiration time from a token.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: FastAPI dependency to get the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: get_optional_user
methods.description: FastAPI dependency to get the current user if available.
